title: Polynomial of a scaled sum
statement: Let $\ell$ be a natural number, let $b\in\mathbb F_2$, and let $p,a\in\mathbb F_2^\ell$. The polynomial associated to the coordinatewise sum $a+bp$ is the polynomial associated to $a$ plus $b$ times the polynomial associated to $p$.
